text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PROD: inference-queue-delay (service=inference-runtime, severity=high) — triggered by 95th-percentile latency > 1200ms. PD incident: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD12345

pagerduty: PagerDuty notification: primary on-call did not acknowledge within 2m. Escalating to secondary: leah.

devon: acked. looking. I see backend redis queue spikes + a couple of GC spikes on gpu nodes. digging into logs now.

leah: seeing the escalation. grabbing access to the prod dashboard. give me 2m to check scaling.

sam: manager pinged by PD (auto-escalation). Sam here, if secondary can't stabilize in 10m we'll consider failover to warm pool.

maria: adding context — earlier today we deployed a model variant with larger kv cache. Could be increased memory pressure. watching node cpu/mem.

devon: confirming, heap growth on inference-03 and inference-04, OOM events around 2 min ago. stack traces show `kv_cache` allocations near the new model.

leah: temporarily routing traffic away from inference-03/04 via weights: `curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/route/update -d '{"service":"inference","remove_nodes":["inference-03","inference-04"]}'` (ran). :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Automated action: removed nodes inference-03,inference-04 from traffic group 'prod-inference' by request of leah.

devon: restarting runtime on those nodes to free memory: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference-runtime -n prod --field-selector=metadata.name=inference-03` (running now).

maria: starting a provisional horizontal scale: +2 replicas on warm pool (policy=fast-burst). This will take ~45s.

pagerduty: PD note: manager escalation triggered (sam). Mobile page sent to manager.

sam: got the page. thanks. if restarts fail we will trigger model fallback to quantized model v1.2.0 (lower mem).

devon: restart completed for inference-03. memory stable. queue latency dropping.

leah: warm pool scaled, routing adjusted back incrementally. metrics (p95 latency) trending down from 1300ms -> 340ms.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident mitigated (partial): latency returned to acceptable threshold for most traffic, ongoing verification for persisted sessions. Suggested follow-up: rollback model variant or pin quantized model; runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-latency

maria: creating internal ticket PD-12345 -> INF-789 for postmortem and deployment rollback plan.

devon: leaving handoff notes: I patched node restarts, routing temporarily shifted, watching overnight. handing to oncall-leah for next 2 hours.

leah: acknowledged handoff. I'll monitor and start a rollback tomorrow morning if we see recurrence.

pagerduty: Closing note: PD auto-escalation chain fired due to missed ack window; primary did not ack in time. Recommend adjusting PD policy thresholds or ensuring primary mobile alerts reach on-call.

sam: thanks team. quick debrief in #incidents-retros in the AM. :coffee:

incident-bot: Logging thread: incident id PD12345, severity=high, duration=16m, mitigation=scale+restart+route-weighting.
